triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '12. `cute.recast_tensor` only accepts Numeric dtypes (not vector types)' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 12. `cute.recast_tensor` only accepts Numeric dtypes (not vector types)

problem.statement: CuTeDSL GDN Decode on sm_120 — Pitfalls -- 12. `cute.recast_tensor` only accepts Numeric dtypes (not vector types)

payload.attempted: View a `[K, V]` fp32 fragment as a `[K, V/4]` vec4_f32 fragment to do bulk vec stores:
payload.lesson: To get vector-typed elements from a fragment, build the vector explicitly per-row using `cute.arch.vector.from_elements` (and Pitfall 9 about `.value`).

established_fact.mechanism: `recast_tensor` is for changing element dtype (e.g. fp32 ↔ bf16), not for re-wrapping a region as a vector view.

payload.root_cause: `recast_tensor` is for changing element dtype (e.g. fp32 ↔ bf16), not for re-wrapping a region as a vector view.

implementation.snippet:
```python
vec4_f32_t = ir.VectorType.get([4], cutlass.Float32.mlir_type)
state_vec = cute.recast_tensor(state, vec4_f32_t)
```

